cv.name: Sophie Wendland
cv.headline: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director | Office & Events Management
cv.summary: Executive assistant with seven years supporting managing directors in shipping and consumer goods. I also run the office side of a 120-person site, from facility contracts to onboarding and company events, so I can work as an EA or as an office manager.

bullets: Manage the calendar, travel and correspondence of the managing director and two board members
Prepare board meetings, minutes and follow-up tracking for the supervisory board
Run office management for the Hamburg site: facility contracts, budget of around €400k, supplier negotiations
Organised the company's 150th anniversary event for 600 guests
Coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires with HR and IT

experience.title: Team Assistant Marketing & Sales
bullets: Supported a team of 14 with trade-fair planning, purchase orders and travel
Introduced a shared booking tool for meeting rooms and pool cars

experience.title: Office Assistant (part-time)
bullets: Front desk, incoming mail and appointment scheduling for a law firm

skills: Confidential correspondence in German and English
